verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 is a data-center GPU, and user-configurable background automations are a software or agent-platform capability, not something a GPU ships. The evidence covers only hardware specs and adjacent NVIDIA software (CUDA, NIM, Brev). None of it shows the H200 itself offering scheduled or autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
